description:
Why this issue exists: server.rs defines const SINGLETON_USER_ID: i64 = 1 with no comment explaining why 1 is the value or that this constant is only valid for a single-user v1 deployment. Any developer reading the code must trace all uses to understand the scope constraint. The constant is used in resolve_user_id fallback (see separate P1 bug) and in route_method.

What needs to be done: Add a doc comment: '/// Single-user v1 deployment: the only provisioned DB user ID. /// This constant must be removed when multi-user support is added.' This makes the architectural constraint explicit at the definition site.
title: SINGLETON_USER_ID comment lacks single-user scope caveat
